name: Enrich Emails
description: Verifies the provider address in Email for every person in a People view with MillionVerifier; if it failed, the domain pattern and six common guesses; LeadMagic last. Writes Final Email and the lane. A person on a catch-all domain keeps Email as it is and goes to Verify Catch-alls with Status verifying; guesses never reach BounceBan. One run per client at a time.
